highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux applications relying on fontconfig fallback should verify selected typefaces after upgrading.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection is required.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and includes the related upstream browser, buffer-upload, and correctness fixes.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the 4.153 line with the Skia m153 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the preview line for release validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves the Windows build configuration for the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: It brings the current upstream renderer into the 4.153 line.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 finalizes the m153 preview line.
